title: Chrome Extension Superset & Generated Funnel Surface Roadmap
objective: Make Chrome a first-class canonical Titan Zero surface: one maximal MV3 superset source containing all eligible modes/capabilities, with smaller marketplace funnel extensions generated as mode/vertical/release projections rather than feature forks.

code_discovery.scan_notes: The governed Chrome workspace is intentionally a scaffold; Superset Source and REGISTRY are empty and do not authorize a rewrite. Valid Chrome requirements must converge from Merge80, Titan Code, Forge/MCP and recoverable historical donors. OpenBrowser Bridge is SHA/provenance verified but its recorded store/workspace path is stale; LLM Prompt Queue is registry-verified but its payload/hash are unresolved. Record old Chrome plans as superseded only after requirement coverage is proven.

goal_claim_rule: NEVER CLAIMABLE: Builders claim one contained sub-goal.
agent_goal_rule: This goal delivers an authorised surface/host projection. It MUST NOT create agents because of the surface. Reuse canonical domain agents where user journeys require them; otherwise classify technical subgoals NO_AGENT_INFRASTRUCTURE_ONLY.
workforce_goal_rule: Never create PWA, Chrome, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, MCP, iOS, Android, Flutter or other host-specific workforce identities. Bind existing canonical domain agents only where the surface exposes their capabilities.
